# DocuGen by ReflectMyIdea

## Document Automation

### DocuGen turns your existing templates and data into compliant, locked reports — in seconds. Automates compliance reports, agreements, MOUs, NDAs, and SLAs. An enterprise-grade document automation pipeline that eliminates manual drafting errors by generating validated reports from Word templates and Excel workbooks.

- ReflectMyIdea builds automation around the process you already trust. DocuGen turns your existing Word templates and Excel data into compliant, locked reports — in seconds.

## DocuGen : For paperwork that can't afford errors.

## Feature : Cell data, Tables, Dynamic range of cells, Excel Chart, Excel image object, External image files, External PDF files with selective page, External word files for common data, Import data from Database, Support for multiple tempates

### DocuGen turns your existing Word templates and Excel data into compliant, locked reports — in seconds.
DocuGen is offered as a customized software development service that extends our core technology to build an internal tool tailored to your business needs. The solution is designed around your existing reports, integrates with your legacy data source systems and is deployed on your server, giving you a solution that fits your workflows and infrastructure.

* Reuse existing documents, Excel files and calculations
* Support text, tables, charts, images and PDFs
* Define business rules for data validation
* Import data from SQL databases
* Easily update templates with latest references
* Avoid repeat data entry from existing systems
* Lock and secure generated documents
* Flexible to add your unique requirement

DocuGen technology stack — SQL Server , Word , Excel , VBA , ASP.NET Core
	  
## DocuGen is valuable wherever strict regulatory, legal, or operational document requirements exist.

### Life Sciences and CROs : CSRs, protocol amendments, informed consent forms, FDA/EMA compliance documentation.

### Financial and Banking : Loan agreements, KYC/AML reporting, RBI regulatory filings, risk assessment reports.

### Legal Services : High-volume NDAs, SOWs, retainer agreements, employment contracts.

### Healthcare : HIPAA disclosures, Business Associate Agreements, clinical trial agreements.

### IT and Software : Software licensing, technical SLAs, DPAs, vendor NDAs, ISO/SOC compliance.

### Real Estate and Construction : Lease agreements, sub-contractor contracts, procurement MOUs, safety reports.

### Logistics and Supply Chain : Freight forwarding agreements, customs compliance, vendor SLAs.

### Government and Public Sector : Tender documents, audit reports, inter-agency MOUs, statutory compliance reporting.

# FAQs

## What is DocuGen?
### A customized software service that converts Word templates and data from various source (Excel, Database) into locked, compliant reports instantly on your own server.

## Do we need to replace our current business logic?
### No, it preserves your validated formulas / calculations and domain knowledge. Your existing data and logic is used as it is.

## How DocuGen will support our internal security guidelines?
### We offer two flexible structural approaches depending on your security demands:
* Option A (Enterprise Web Application): A secure, multi-user web application deployed locally on your server featuring centralized infrastructure, role permissions, and full lifecycle logs.
* Option B (Independent Excel File): A portable, macro-powered setup requiring zero infrastructure adjustments, ideal for quick deployment within localized silos.

## What formats are supported?
### DocuGen currently supports Text, Tables, Charts, Images, PDF file and SQL database integration. It is highly customizable and can be updated to support your custom format.

## How does DocuGen guarantee data security and privacy?
### Your confidential data never leaves your environment. DocuGen is deployed directly on your secure server, entirely eliminating third-party hosting risks.

## Is DocuGen compliant with strict regulatory standards (FDA, GLP, HIPAA)?
### DocuGen is engineered for compliance. However, compliance is a joint responsibility achieved by how the system is engineered and how your infrastructure is managed. We will identify specific technical, administrative, and procedural safeguards required for your compliance needs. e.g. Clinical Study Reports (CSRs), BAA, IQ, OQ, PQ.

## How does the system ensure report compliance and prevent manual errors?
### DocuGen establishes a single source of truth by securing generated documents. Under the Enterprise Web App architecture, system enforces total document integrity through central role-based access controls, comprehensive data validation rules and automated audit trails tracking user activity.

## Can DocuGen automatically add corporate seals, timestamps, and signatures?
### Yes using our specialized PDF Post-Processing tools. Actions are defined for custom text, stamp, and signature placement. For instance, corporate stamp, signature are automatically applied sequentially across 200+ page output documents instantly.
